title: Ten Mile Bay North Group Site

services.name: Campsite
services.desc: Camp Cove Group Campsite is located on the West Side of Harrison Lake. With a large open area that is suitable for 10 large RVs plus several level spots suitable for tents. The site has a communal fire ring as well as a couple of picnic tables. Perfect for your family or small group gatherings. The Chehalis River Group Site is suitable for 5-10 RVs plus room for tents. Situated amongst mature timbers, borders the Chehalis River, in the Fraser Valley of BC., and offers excellent steelhead and salmon fishing opportunities. This group site is perfect for multi-family gatherings. Small group campsite situated near Grace Lake, in the Fraser Valley, BC. Semi-private and suitable for up to 4
